title: [Request] Rabbit Fighter SV Battler and Character

posts.author: maxdevige
posts.body:
Hello,
I am currently developing a game in a workshop with middle school students. Due to time constraints, I am turning to the community for help with a particular asset.
The students have imagined a humanoid rabbit character, silent and mysterious, who fights hand-to-hand but with magical techniques (fire fists, ice kicks, etc.).
I need two files for RPG Maker MZ to bring this character to life (the kids would be so happy!): I need a “characters” file and a “battler_sv” file.
I created draft files with the RPG Maker MZ character generator, but they are really unsatisfactory and insufficient for what we want to do.
I know it's wrong, but I also generated images using AI based on the students' descriptions to show what we have in mind. THESE ARE NOT "ASSETS" THAT I AM SHARING, THEY ARE SIMPLY TO SHOW WHAT THIS CHARACTER LOOKS LIKE.
Spoiler:
Demonstration images
AI-generated portrait :
Walking Character made with RMMZ Character Generator :
SV Battler made with RMMZ Character Generator :
I would be very grateful to anyone who is willing to take the time to create these images for us. And, of course, I am available if you need any further information.
Thank you all.
PS: Sorry if my English is a bit rough ^^

Sorry, English is not my native language, so I may not express myself very well.
First of all, I don't want to seem like I'm nitpicking when you're kindly offering your help. Please know that I am extremely grateful to you.
The “comment” I took the liberty of making on this first sprite was that the round head seemed a little strange to me, too smooth, and that giving it a more “hairy” effect would take this “wip” from ‘great’ to “perfect.” That's what I thought, but I may be completely wrong, especially if you tell me that it was your first version and that it's better this way, but personally, I think this first version (the one you just sent) is pretty good !
Anyway, I'm trying to explain myself, but I feel like I'm digging myself into a hole and coming across as even more nitpicky ^^'.
To sum up: I think your work is really great, I can finally see this character come to life for the first time and I'm very happy about that. If you have the time and energy to finish this sheet, I will be eternally grateful.
Thank you very much for your time.
